_status: VERIFIED. Finalize completes with a final token {"text":"<fin>","is_final":true}. Docs advise calling finalize ~200 ms after speech silence. Keepalive: send at least every 20 s during streaming when not sending audio (5-10 s typical); stream otherwise ends 408 request_timeout. Before the start request: at least every 40 s else WS close 1001. Idle time is billed.
end_of_stream: Send an EMPTY TEXT frame (not an empty binary frame). Server flushes then sends the finished message and closes.
